evidence: Implements BIP 54 soft fork consensus validation logic in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Implements validation rules addressing long-standing consensus vulnerabilities including legacy sigop quadratic hashing, 64-byte Merkle tree collisions, and difficulty adjustment timewarp attacks. Because it is scoped to regtest without mainnet activation, delay does not present an immediate category-critical emergency, but deliberate review is strategically important for consensus security and testing.
